title: Function item effect outcome
description: Executes a function (based on the given resource location), see docs: https://minecraft.wiki/w/Function_(Java_Edition)

function.$comment: A resource location referencing the function to execute.

position.$comment: The position to execute the function at, ~ coordinate values will be based on this value. Possibly optional depending on the function.

entity.$comment: The @s target selector will reference this entity.
